request.style: English, female voice, solo with choir, piano, strings, flute, cello, warm, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Jacob's children gathered round
Asher stood among the sons
Imnah first and Ishvah there
Ishvi named in ancient lands
Beriah walked with them all
And his sister Serah too
Her name was kept in holy text
Part of Jacob's house of two

[Chorus]
The sons of Asher by their clans
From Imnah the Imnite line
From Ishvi the Ishvite name
From Beriah the Beriite shine
Serah was the daughter's name
Recorded in the census plain
Seventy souls went down to stay
In the land of Egypt's grain

[Verse]
Chronicles tell the family tree
Asher's sons are listed clear
Imnah Ishvah Ishvi and Beriah
Serah stands beside them near
Heber son of Beriah too
Malchiel his brother's name
Father of Birzaith they say
In the book of life's own frame

[Chorus]
The sons of Asher by their clans
From Imnah the Imnite line
From Ishvi the Ishvite name
From Beriah the Beriite shine
Serah was the daughter's name
Recorded in the census plain
Seventy souls went down to stay
In the land of Egypt's grain

[Bridge]
Names preserved in holy scroll
Not forgotten in the tale
Daughter Serah stands apart
In the genealogy's veil

[Outro]
Serah's name is spoken still
In the records old and new
